items.title: The RISC-V Reader (Patterson & Waterman)
items.blurb: Compact ISA introduction — the fastest way to read RV32I before the unprivileged spec.

items.title: Digital Design and Computer Architecture: RISC-V Edition
items.blurb: Datapath, pipeline, and memory from gates to a RISC-V core — the SoC-adjacent textbook.

items.title: The RISC-V Instruction Set Manual
items.blurb: Unprivileged and privileged ISA specs — the contract every core and toolchain has to honor.

items.title: RISC-V Privileged Architecture
items.blurb: M/S/U modes, CSRs, traps, virtual memory — required reading before an MMU or Linux port.

items.title: AMBA AXI / ACE Protocol Specification
items.blurb: The dominant SoC interconnect contract: channels, ordering, and what caches actually promise.

items.title: TileLink Specification (SiFive / Rocket Chip)
items.blurb: The coherent bus used by Rocket, BOOM, and Chipyard — different tradeoffs from AXI.

items.title: OpenTitan documentation
items.blurb: How an open root of trust is specified, verified, and taken through a silicon lifecycle.

items.title: OpenLane / OpenROAD documentation
items.blurb: Practical RTL-to-GDS on SKY130 and GF180 — the flow most open tapeouts actually run.

items.title: CHERI ISA and software papers
items.blurb: Capability hardware, compartmentalization, and what CHERI-RISC-V changes in the compiler.

items.title: Hot Chips archives
items.blurb: CPU, GPU, and accelerator architecture talks that usually precede product announcements.
